candidates.description: This vector represents common adjectives and descriptive qualifiers across multiple languages.

This vector represents high-frequency Spanish verbs and related grammatical morphemes.
This feature vector activates on word fragments, roots, and proper nouns spanning multiple languages, primarily related to morphological suffixes and base lexical tokens.
This vector represents adverbs and adjectives related to difference, significance, and specificity across Romance languages.
This vector represents adjectives denoting standard, authentic, or general qualities.

This vector represents geographic locations, regional suffixes, and city-related proper noun components.
This feature vector activates on tokens containing roots related to freedom, liberation, and autonomous self-determination across multiple languages.
